steps: Apply with Cherokee County Elections (citizen, 16+, background check)
Report 6:00 a.m. Election Day until released
catches: 14+-hour day (6 a.m.–8 p.m.+); clerk rate is $170 for the full day.
biggest_catch: $170 clerk pay for a 14+ hour day — roughly $12/hour.
